s1.syndrome_frame: Recurrent painful ulcerations with livedo pattern on lower limbs
salient_findings: Reticular purplish livedo pattern on both lower limbs
Multiple chronic, nonhealing ulcers on the lateral malleolus and the dorsum of the left foot
White atrophic scars on the lower legs and ankles
key_facts: 31-year-old woman
4-year history of recurrent painful ulcerations
No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease
No arthralgia or other dermatologic symptoms
No tobacco or illicit drug use
No medications
Reticular purplish livedo pattern on both lower limbs
Multiple chronic, nonhealing ulcers
White atrophic scars on the lower legs and ankles
Lesional skin biopsy was performed

shortlist.label: Livedoid vasculopathy
shortlist.why_kept: Reticular purplish livedo pattern and chronic nonhealing ulcers on lower limbs

shortlist.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful ulcerations and livedo pattern, possible thrombophilia

shortlist.label: Thrombophilia
shortlist.why_kept: Recurrent painful ulcerations and livedo pattern, possible clotting disorder

shortlist.label: Immune-mediated vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic nonhealing ulcers and livedo pattern, possible autoimmune component

shortlist.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
shortlist.why_kept: Chronic nonhealing ulcers and livedo pattern, possible medium-vessel vasculitis

raw.rationale: The patient's presentation of recurrent painful ulcerations, reticular purplish livedo pattern, and multiple chronic nonhealing ulcers is most consistent with livedoid vasculopathy, which is characterized by these clinical features.

rejected.label: Antiphospholipid syndrome
rejected.why: No personal or family history of vascular or autoimmune disease

rejected.label: Thrombophilia
rejected.why: Not explicitly confirmed and other options better explain the clinical presentation

rejected.label: Immune-mediated vasculitis
rejected.why: No arthralgia or other dermatologic symptoms suggestive of systemic vasculitis

rejected.label: Polyarteritis nodosa
rejected.why: Typically involves medium-sized arteries and presents with systemic symptoms, which are not mentioned in the vignette
